That's a nice ending for the pile. I marked the last item read, the count dropped to zero, and instead of a cold empty box I got a friendly "you're all caught up" — with the reminder that nothing was thrown away, just cleared off my to-read stack. That reassurance matters to me every time, not just once; I never want to wonder whether emptying the pile also emptied my library. And the single "Browse library" button gave me an obvious way back rather than leaving me stranded on an empty page.

So yes — right ending for the reading pile. What's next?
